body.text: I have settled on what {param:town} is for, and I should rather you heard it from me than from the returns.
It is to be {param:intent}. I have turned it over a good while and I think it is right, though I am the first to say I see one valley and you see an ocean.

If you would have me elsewhere, say so and say it plainly. I will not pretend a letter from you weighs nothing with me; it does, and I would rather be argued with now than found fault with in three years.
Nothing is spent yet. The men are told what they are doing this month and no further.

tone.text: As to the course you have set, I am {choice}.

options.text: glad of your judgement and glad you asked
less certain of it than you are
uneasy, and I will say why

options.label: carry on as you have decided
options.text: Carry on as you have decided. You are the man on the spot and I am not.

options.label: attend to the colony's profit
options.text: Attend to the colony's profit. That is what you are there for, and what the Crown will ask me about.

options.label: see to your defences
options.text: See to your defences. I would rather pay for walls I did not need than explain why there were none.

options.label: see that the town grows
options.text: See that the town grows. A place with nobody in it returns nothing, whatever the ledgers say.
